# The Pathfinder 2e fixtures as a deck

Every German card note in this folder — the English ones say
`language: en` and stay out — in the order `card-type:` lists them. The
creature card type prints `large` on its own; a deck is one grid, so
`card-size:` here puts every card on poker.

```cardsmith-deck
system: pf2e
card-type: [creature, item, feat, action, trap]
card-languages: de
card-size: poker
paper-size: A4 portrait
```
